data.long_meaning: Anokhika is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘anokha’ which means ‘rare’ or ‘unique’. This name is often given to a child who is considered a precious and rare gift. The name Anokhika carries the meaning “Rare, Unique” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anokhika usually hope their child will grow to embody rare, unique and live with faith, good character and purpose.
